newsitem.title: USA: 3d Image Tech to make cameras for Wal-Mart.
newsitem.headline: 3d Image Tech to make cameras for Wal-Mart.

text.p: 3D Image Technology Inc said on Tuesday that it will be making cameras for sale at Wal-Mart Stores.
The 3D Magic Plus single-use cameras are to be manufactured as part of an agreement the company has with Kalimar Inc, which markets and distributes photographic equipment.
The cameras on the Wal-Mart shelves will be known as "Spirit Fun 3D Magic Plus." The price was not disclosed.
The company did not immediately disclose the number of cameras it plans to manufacturer for Wal-Mart.
